title: Rellinger Weg, Hamburg
description:
❤️ This spacious and modern apartment is perfect for business travelers seeking a home away from home! 🌠

Welcome to this spacious 3-bedroom apartment in Eimsbüttel, perfect for business travelers looking for a home away from home. This apartment offers modern furnishings and can accommodate up to 5 guests. 

The living area exudes a calm and functional vibe, designed for both relaxation and productivity. Unwind after a day of meetings with your favorite shows on TV. Step into the separate, fully equipped kitchen—a true chef's delight. With modern appliances, including an oven and a spacious fridge, plus all the necessary cooking supplies, this kitchen makes preparing meals an absolute pleasure. A bright bathroom with a refreshing shower completes this inviting and convenient space, providing the perfect relaxing base for your stay.

📍Location:
Living in Eimsbüttel means enjoying one of Hamburg’s most popular districts—green, lively, and full of charm. Beautiful old buildings, trendy cafés, and boutique shops line the streets, while parks like Eimsbütteler Park provide plenty of space to relax. With excellent transport links, you’re close to the city center yet surrounded by a welcoming neighborhood feel.

📩 Reach out today for more information — your new space is waiting for you!

title: Seestraße, Halstenbek
description:
Modern, fully furnished studio apartment located on Seestraße in Halstenbek, offering approximately 50 sqm of living space and a west-facing balcony.

The apartment is situated on the 3rd floor and features a bright combined living and sleeping area, a separate kitchen, and a bathroom, accommodating up to two people. A spacious storage room within the apartment provides additional storage space. The sofa can be converted into a sofa bed, offering extra sleeping space for guests.

Amenities include Wi-Fi, laminate flooring, central heating, a fully equipped kitchen, a private cellar compartment, and access to a shared parking space.

The Krupunder S-Bahn station is within close proximity, providing direct access to Hamburg Central Station in approximately 25 minutes. Krupunder Lake is within walking distance, and a variety of shopping facilities (Edeka, Woolworth, Bakery, Pharmacy, etc.) are available nearby within walking distance.

The monthly rent includes utilities. The broadcasting fee is not included and must be paid directly by the tenant to the ARD, ZDF, and Deutschlandradio contribution service.

title: Eichendorffstraße, Schenefeld
description:
Welcome to your bright and lovingly furnished apartment in a quiet location in Schenefeld! Everything you need for a relaxing stay awaits you in this 61 m2 apartment:

- The living room invites you to relax with its comfortable sofa and small balcony. The modern kitchen is fully equipped—including a dishwasher, coffee machine, toaster, and more—and offers space for up to 3 people in the beautiful dining area.

- A practical workspace with an office chair is available for working. In the bedroom, you can sleep comfortably in a 1.80 m bed, and in the smaller room there is an additional 90 cm bed—perfect for children or guests.

- The stylish bathroom ensures a fresh start to the day. A washing machine and dryer can be found in the basement. WiFi, electricity, and all utilities are included.

title: Wacholderweg, Rellingen
description:
Vollmöblierte WG-Zimmer in ruhiger 83 qm Wohnung in Rellingen, Nähe Hamburg

Wir vermieten ein gemütliches WG-Zimmer in unserer vollmöblierten 83 qm Wohnung mit viel Tageslicht und freundlicher Atmosphäre. Dank cleverer Bauweise ist das Apartment vor neugierigen Blicken geschützt, und der separate Eingang mit eigenem Parkplatz sorgt für maximale Privatsphäre.
Zur Wohnung gehören:

- 2 Schlafzimmer (15 qm & 10 qm) – das größere Zimmer kann von einem Pärchen genutzt werden

- Großzügiger Wohn-, Ess- und Kochbereich Vollbad mit Dusche

- 20 m2 Terrasse – perfekt für entspannte Stunden draußen

- Begehbarer Kleiderschrank, für Extra lagerplatz

- Kleines Büro – ideal für Homeoffice oder kreative Projekte

- Internetanschluss

Lage & Verkehr:
Ruhige Wohnumgebung in Rellingen, nahe Hamburg
Bus in 10 Gehminuten erreichbar
S-Bahn in 10 Minuten mit dem Fahrrad
Hamburg-Altona in ca. 30 Minuten
A23: Hamburg in 15 Minuten, Küste im Norden ebenfalls schnell erreichbar
Einkaufsmöglichkeiten fußläufig erreichbar
Wenn du ein ruhiges, helles Zimmer in einer freundlichen WG suchst, melde dich gerne!
